description: A looping clip sampled past its last key. Beyond t=0.6 there is no later key, so the bracket closes back onto key 0 read one cycle later: 'pulse' blends from 0.9 toward key 0's 0.1 across the synthetic span, and the stepping channels stay on the LAST key rather than jumping to key 0 early -- 'blinker' is hidden from 0.6 onward and its zIndex stays at 7. This is the case that catches a bracketing copy: a second search that forgot the wrap would hold 0.9 flat to the end of the clip and nothing else would look wrong.
